primary.thesis: LAPTOP will most likely launch before the Dec 31, 2026 deadline, because Hunter Biden has announced it publicly and has an official X channel. It should settle in the tens of millions of dollars of FDV one day after launch. A celebrity token like this on Base typically goes through a launchpad or Uniswap pool with a fixed, large total supply, so it becomes easy to trade immediately. Hunter Biden's notoriety and the political meme angle should bring enough first-day attention to put FDV clearly above $10M. But he is a much weaker draw than a sitting president. The 2025 celebrity and political tokens (TRUMP, MELANIA, LIBRA and many smaller ones) usually spiked in the first hours and then sold off hard as insiders and snipers exited. By 4 PM ET the next day, that post-launch selling should have taken the valuation well below the $100M+ range. Base also has thinner memecoin liquidity than Solana, which caps the upside. The expected result is YES on the lowest rung and NO on the upper rungs.

basket.reason: Once it is tradable, a publicized launch tied to a famous name almost always attracts enough speculative buying to clear a $10M FDV, even after a partial dump.
Staying above $100M the next afternoon would need buying that lasts past the first-hours spike. For a second-tier political celebrity on Base, heavy insider and sniper selling makes that unlikely.
$250M+ one day in has been reached by very few celebrity tokens, essentially only presidential or cabinet-level names with exchange backing.
$1B FDV for a Hunter Biden token would take a TRUMP-scale mania, and nothing in the setup suggests one.

failure_narrative: The basket loses in two ways. (a) Upside: LAPTOP catches a viral political-meme wave. That could come from media outrage, cross-partisan irony buying, a Coinbase or Base ecosystem promotion, or listings on major exchanges within hours. The token then holds above $100M (or even $250M) FDV at 4 PM ET the next day, which breaks the NO legs. (b) Downside: the token launches but is sniped and rugged, or is distrusted as a scam. The next-day FDV then collapses below $10M, or the launch slips past Dec 31, 2026, and the C1 YES leg loses. Case (a) is the more damaging one, because it breaks three legs at once.
hedge_thesis: The primary mainly fails when there is a broad speculative, risk-on memecoin mania at launch time. In that setting even second-tier celebrity tokens hold nine-figure valuations for a day. The same conditions would show up elsewhere in crypto: ETH and Base-ecosystem tokens rallying, Coinbase trading volume and share price rising, memecoin indices such as PEPE, DOGE and TRUMP moving up, and launchpad activity surging on Zora, Clanker and Pump.fun. The mechanism is shared: abundant retail risk appetite and liquidity rotating into memes lift celebrity-token valuations and these other assets together. So being long crypto and memecoin beta, or long Coinbase, tends to pay in exactly the worlds where LAPTOP's FDV runs above $100M.
